fixtures.reason: An explicit wall title is corroborated by continue-reading copy.
The original article title is retained while multiple independent offer signals block access.
A genuine text-heavy wall remains detectable above 4,000 normalized characters.
A free-article limit is corroborated by sign-in or account-recovery instructions.
A short article discusses and quotes subscription-wall copy.
Long-form prose quotes multiple wall and offer phrases without blocking its reader.
A complete article contains a non-blocking subscription promotion in its footer.
The requested membership destination is itself a non-article page, not substitute content blocking a requested article.

decisions: Each weak wall-support phrase contributes independently up to a family cap.
Long-body classification requires several independent wall/support signals and must reject long prose that merely quotes a wall and an offer.
Retaining the original article title does not prevent wall detection.
The wall and wall_support families together can reach the long-body threshold when enough independent support signals are present.
A single subscription offer or footer cannot decide the verdict.
